newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moevenpick 1996 sales down, sees profit up.
newsitem.headline: Moevenpick 1996 sales down, sees profit up.

text.p: Swiss restaurant and hotel group Moevenpick AG said that its 1996 sales fell slightly by 0.3 percent to 1.112 billion Swiss francs ($780.7 million) from 1.116 billion reported in 1995.

In a statement outlining its results for last year, it also said that it expected its profit for 1996 to be "signficantly" higher than the 15.2 million francs reported for 1995. ($ = 1.424 Swiss Francs)
Moevenpick said that its international restaurant division had shown a profit, meaning that all of its divisions are now in the black.
The group will present results at the end of March, and will hold its annual media briefing on April 15.
